resources.string: Android\'s battery report on this phone does not use mAh. Activity+ is still working out its unit (it needs two reports that agree, read every 3 hours and when you plug in), so for now it shows each app\'s share only.

plurals.name: bg_left_out
plurals.item: Android\'s battery report on this phone currently gives %d app an impossible value, more than the battery gave in total since the last charge. That app is left out until the next charge.
